import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
n = 100
# 50 points at x=-10 (category 'a'), 50 at x=+10 (category 'b').
x = np.concatenate([np.full(50, -10.0), np.full(50, 10.0)])
y = rng.uniform(-3, 3, n)
df = pd.DataFrame({'x': x, 'y': y, 'cat': ['a']*50 + ['b']*50})

steps.name: set coords columns to x,y
steps.eval: a.prepare = { ...a.prepare, coordsColumns: { x: a.describe.columns.findIndex(c => c.name === 'x'), y: a.describe.columns.findIndex(c => c.name === 'y') } }; a.runPrepare()

steps.name: set large point size for visible pixels
count pixels on right side without symbol (all circles)
steps.eval: await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(r)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; const ctx = cv.getContext('2d'); ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = ctx.getImageData(cv.width/2, 0, cv.width/2, cv.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__circlePixels = n

steps.name: count pixels on right side with symbols applied
steps.eval: await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(r)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; const ctx = cv.getContext('2d'); ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = ctx.getImageData(cv.width/2, 0, cv.width/2, cv.height).data; let n = 0; for (let k = 0; k < d.length; k += 4) if (d[k] + d[k+1] + d[k+2] > 60) n++; window.__squarePixels = n
steps.report: { circlePixels: window.__circlePixels, squarePixels: window.__squarePixels, ratio: window.__squarePixels / window.__circlePixels }

steps.name: verify symbol shapes render differently — squares occupy less area than circles of same size
steps.report: { circlePixels: window.__circlePixels, squarePixels: window.__squarePixels, ratio: (window.__squarePixels / window.__circlePixels).toFixed(3) }
